Callout.Name: Noise Complaint
Callout.Message: Repeated noise complaint from a residential address.
Callout.Advisory: Loud music, several neighbours have called.

Script.Line: It is a Saturday night. It is music, not a crime.
The neighbours have complained five times and it is always them.
I will turn it down. Look, I am turning it down.

Lines.Approach: Fifth call this week from the same neighbours.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
